slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the objective before READY_TO_MODEL; it only mentioned the objective as a caveat after already assuming profit maximization in its provisional answer.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to maximize total profit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked or received confirmation about the objective; it assumed profit maximization and only noted it as a caveat after presenting the provisional recommendation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 objective slot remained unresolved, silently assuming profit maximization.

summary: The agent failed to ask about the core objective and became stuck repeatedly questioning an unconfirmed whole-unit assumption, then stopped with the P0 objective unresolved and silently assumed profit maximization.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
